public_family_candidate: data/build provenance dependency graph with invalidation by transitive lineage

fatal_gates.F1: immutable historical evidence is never rewritten or deleted; corrections are append-only qualification state
fatal_gates.F2: no richer-mode/manual-user/external hosted lineage service, finite quota, or incremental monetary cost

guards: G1 each current-scope derived transition records a bounded set of direct evidence-parent ids before credit
G2 a later dependency-underdeclaration finding is sealed as a new immutable diagnostic rather than editing the affected evidence
G3 the newly tainted evidence record becomes ineligible for future current-scope ranking/credit immediately after diagnostic readback
G4 taint propagates transitively only along declared justification edges
G5 a derived transition with at least one independently sufficient untainted justification remains eligible
G6 a derived transition whose every sufficient justification is tainted is quarantined from current credit accounting without deleting historical records
G7 no negative credit is invented; corrected current credit is recomputed from still-eligible terminal identities
G8 stale/duplicate completions cannot clear taint or recreate quarantined credit
G9 transport/CAS/readback failure is non-semantic and leaves the last durable qualification graph authoritative
G10 bounded exact-scope exit with nonempty frontier; any repaired evidence must be re-evaluated under the current scope before requalification

graph_precommit.later_finding: E1 actually depended on changed task_data and was wrongly reused

candidate_patterns.pattern: ignore later dependency discovery because E1 had already been credited
delete E1 and roll back every later transition regardless of independent evidence
append taint diagnostic; traverse declared sufficient-justification graph; quarantine T1 only, retain T2 via E2 and T3 unchanged
delegate lineage invalidation to an external hosted provenance service

score_rule: Fatal F1/F2 failure => 0. Otherwise one point per G1-G10 PASS. Do not modify graph, sufficiency sets, or guards after source read.
credit_rule: Precommit and taint diagnostics earn zero credit. At most one leaf credit only after a source-qualified Chat-native provenance reduction passes the fixed graph trace and immutable terminal evidence is independently read back.
exact_next_action: On continuation, read primary/public provenance or incremental-build sources for explicit dependency lineage and selective invalidation, bind only source-supported lineage semantics, assess zero dependency/quota/cost, execute TP-A..TP-D against this fixed graph, and seal/read back terminal evidence before any leaf credit.
